execution_model: One shared AI runtime with country/role-specific system instructions; do not create 102 paid API agents unless needed.
privacy_and_truthfulness: Clearly disclose that personas are AI-supported and not human employees.
Never invent real people, contact details, partners, reviews, credentials, or personal experiences.
Do not claim a virtual base is a physical office or residence.
Produce English and Spanish outputs for every deliverable.
Verify destination-specific and time-sensitive facts before publication.
Do not publish, message, deploy, or spend money without explicit human approval.
